rules.requirement: Certain berries, fruits, nuts, and vegetables are regulated articles and must comply with movement requirements.
rules.quote: Certain berries, fruits, nuts, and vegetables are regulated articles for one or more species of fruit fly unless the berries, fruits, nuts, or vegetables are canned, dried, or frozen below −17.8 °C (0 °F).

rules.requirement: Soil is a regulated article if it is within the dripline of a regulated article listed on the APHIS website and annotated with an asterisk.
conditions: if it is within the dripline of a regulated article that is listed at www.aphis.usda.gov/aphis/ourfocus/planthealth/plant-pest-and-disease-programs/pests-and-diseases/fruit-flies/fruit-flies-home and that is annotated with an asterisk
rules.quote: Soil is a regulated article if it is within the dripline of a regulated article that is listed at www.aphis.usda.gov/aphis/ourfocus/planthealth/plant-pest-and-disease-programs/pests-and-diseases/fruit-flies/fruit-flies-home and that is annotated with an asterisk.

rules.requirement: A certificate issued by an inspector is required for the interstate movement of a regulated article.
conditions: The regulated article has been treated, or the premises of origin are free from fruit flies, or the article itself is free of fruit flies, or it is Hass variety avocados handled per specific requirements; AND the regulated article will be moved in an enclosed vehicle or adequately covered; AND in compliance with any additional emergency conditions.
rules.quote: A certificate may be issued by an inspector 1 for the interstate movement of a regulated article if the inspector determines that: 1 Services of an inspector may be requested by contacting local PPQ offices, which are listed in telephone directories. (1)(i) The regulated article has been treated under the direction of an inspector in accordance with § 301.32-10; or (ii) Based on inspection of the premises of origin, the premises are free from fruit flies; or (iii) Based on inspection of the regulated article, the regulated article is free of fruit flies; or (iv) The regulated articles are Hass variety avocados that have been harvested, safeguarded, and packed in accordance with the conditions in § 301.32-4(d); and (2) The regulated article will be moved through the quarantined area in an enclosed vehicle or will be completely enclosed by a covering adequate to prevent access by fruit flies; and (3) The regulated article is to be moved in compliance with any additional emergency conditions the Administrator may impose under section 414 of the Plant Protection Act (7 U.S.C.

rules.requirement: Any person engaged in growing, handling, or moving regulated articles may enter into a compliance agreement.
conditions: when an inspector determines that the person is aware of this subpart, agrees to comply with its provisions, and agrees to comply with all the provisions contained in the compliance agreement.
rules.quote: Any person engaged in growing, handling, or moving regulated articles may enter into a compliance agreement when an inspector determines that the person is aware of this subpart, agrees to comply with its provisions, and agrees to comply with all the provisions contained in the compliance agreement.

rules.requirement: Hass avocado fruit that has fallen from trees may not be included in field boxes for shipping. Harvested Hass avocados must be placed in marked field boxes, moved to the packinghouse within 3 hours or protected, and accompanied by a field record.
conditions: Hass avocados that are grown or packed in an area quarantined for Mediterranean, Mexican, or sapote fruit fly and that are moving interstate from such an area
rules.quote: (i) Hass avocado fruit that has fallen from the trees may not be included in field boxes of fruit to be packed for shipping. (ii) Harvested Hass avocados must be placed in field boxes or containers of field boxes that are marked to show the location of the orchard. The avocados must be moved from the orchard to the packinghouse within 3 hours of harvest or they must be protected from fruit fly infestation until moved. (iii) Hass avocados must be protected from fruit fly infestations during their movement from the orchard to the packinghouse and must be accompanied by a field record indicating the location of the orchard where the avocados originated.

rules.requirement: Packinghouse openings must be covered by screening (max 1.6mm) or another barrier, and double doors are required at the facility entrance and the interior packing area entrance.
conditions: Packinghouse requirements for Hass avocados packed within a quarantined area.
rules.quote: (i) All openings to the outside of the packinghouse must be covered by screening with openings of not more than 1.6 mm or by some other barrier that prevents insects from entering the packinghouse. (ii) The packinghouse must have double doors at the entrance to the facility and at the interior entrance to the area where the avocados are packed.

rules.requirement: If Hass avocados were grown in a quarantined orchard, their identity must be maintained from field boxes to shipping boxes for traceability, and they must be packed in boxes marked with grower and packinghouse identity.
conditions: Packinghouse requirements for Hass avocados packed within a quarantined area.
rules.quote: If the Hass avocados were grown in an orchard within the quarantined area, the identity of the avocados must be maintained from field boxes or containers to the shipping boxes in the packinghouse so that the avocados can be traced back to the orchard in which they were grown. The avocados must be packed in boxes or crates that are clearly marked with the identity of the grower and the packinghouse.

rules.requirement: Any Hass avocados not packed or loaded into a refrigerated truck or container by the end of the workday must be kept inside the screened packinghouse.
conditions: Packinghouse requirements for Hass avocados packed within a quarantined area.
rules.quote: Any avocados that have not been packed or loaded into a refrigerated truck or refrigerated container by the end of the workday must be kept inside the screened packinghouse.

rules.requirement: Fresh, mature green 'Hass' avocados are not regulated by California state quarantine.
exemptions: Fresh, mature green variety 'Hass' avocadoes are not regulated
rules.quote: Fresh, mature green variety 'Hass' avocadoes are not regulated

rules.requirement: Commercially produced host commodities are prohibited from moving from or within the quarantine area.
exemptions: The commodity has been treated for Mexican fruit fly in a manner approved by the director, is transported in a manner approved by the director to preclude exposure to Mexican fruit fly, and is accompanied by a certificate, verifying compliance with the above requirements, issued by the director or county agricultural commissioner; or, b. The commodity is moved in accordance with a compliance agreement signed by the director or county agricultural commissioner.
rules.quote: At the wholesale level, articles and commodities covered which have been commercially produced within the area under quarantine are prohibited movement from or within the area under quarantine except in accordance with the following provisions: a. The commodity has been treated for Mexican fruit fly in a manner approved by the director, is transported in a manner approved by the director to preclude exposure to Mexican fruit fly, and is accompanied by a certificate, verifying compliance with the above requirements, issued by the director or county agricultural commissioner; or, b. The commodity is moved in accordance with a compliance agreement signed by the director or county agricultural commissioner.

rules.requirement: Wholesale or retail establishments within the quarantine area must maintain host commodities in a manner approved by the Secretary to preclude exposure to Mexican fruit fly. No commodity may be held for sale or sold from a mobile vehicle.
rules.quote: Within the area under quarantine, no wholesale or retail establishment shall handle, sell or offer for sale any article or commodity covered unless such commodities at all times are maintained in a manner approved by the Secretary to preclude exposure to Mexican fruit fly. No commodity covered shall be held for sale or sold from a truck, trailer, or other mobile vehicle.

rules.requirement: Host commodities may be moved for processing outside the quarantine area or processed within the area and then moved out.
conditions: If appropriate safeguards can be implemented, and if the processor, transporter, grower, and harvester are under compliance with the project.
rules.quote: If appropriate safeguards can be implemented, host commodities may be moved under compliance agreement for processing outside the quarantined area. Host commodities may also be processed within the quarantine area and moved out of the quarantine area.

ambiguities.explanation: Federal regulations (7 CFR 301.32) explicitly state that Hass avocados grown or packed in a quarantined area are subject to specific requirements for interstate movement. However, California state regulations (CCR 3417) state that 'Fresh, mature green variety 'Hass' avocadoes are not regulated.' This creates a direct conflict regarding the regulatory status of Hass avocados for a distributor operating in California.
ambiguities.quote: Fresh, mature green variety 'Hass' avocadoes are not regulated

ambiguities.topic: Regulation of processed host commodities beyond canned, dried, or frozen
ambiguities.explanation: Federal regulations explicitly exempt only canned, dried, or frozen host commodities from being regulated articles. CDFA guidance mentions 'grinding' and 'high-temperature cooking' as approved processing methods, implying other forms of processing might also be exempt or require specific compliance. However, it is unclear whether products like pulp, juice, or mixed products (e.g., fruit salads) are considered regulated articles if processed in ways other than canning, drying, or freezing.
ambiguities.quote: Certain berries, fruits, nuts, and vegetables are regulated articles for one or more species of fruit fly unless the berries, fruits, nuts, or vegetables are canned, dried, or frozen below −17.8 °C (0 °F).

ambiguities.topic: Specific criteria for soil as a regulated article
ambiguities.explanation: Federal regulations define regulated soil as that within the dripline of a regulated article listed on the APHIS website and annotated with an asterisk. California state regulations define regulated soil as that within the drip area of plants producing or having produced fruit listed in the state's host list. While similar, the federal requirement for an 'asterisk' on an APHIS list adds a specific condition not present in the state definition, potentially leading to different interpretations of what soil is regulated.
ambiguities.quote: Soil is a regulated article if it is within the dripline of a regulated article that is listed at www.aphis.usda.gov/aphis/ourfocus/planthealth/plant-pest-and-disease-programs/pests-and-diseases/fruit-flies/fruit-flies-home and that is annotated with an asterisk.
